must_haves.item: The three crew match their descriptions and stay the same people throughout.
must_haves.why: Vale has short dark hair, a dark naval coat and brass binoculars; the woman has a blond braid but no rolled sleeves. The male sailor wears a cap, with no visible curly black hair or red headset. All three appear consistent across frames.

must_haves.item: The bridge is narrow steel with slanted front windows, a chart table and cool overhead lamps, remaining the same room throughout.
must_haves.why: The steel platform and chart table remain consistent, but this is an open-air bridge without slanted front windows or cool overhead lamps.

must_haves.item: The lookout points at the horizon, Vale raises binoculars, then lowers them and gives the command to fire.
must_haves.why: The blond woman, rather than the male lookout, points before Vale raises her binoculars. Vale briefly lowers them around 7 seconds, then raises them again and keeps observing through 13 seconds; no clear fire command is visible.

must_haves.item: A small tactical screen with amber graphics is visible on the bridge.
must_haves.why: A console-mounted map display is visible, but its graphics are pale blue-green rather than amber, and vessel tracking is not clearly demonstrated.

must_haves.item: Cold late-afternoon window light; about 15 seconds; widescreen 16:9; no extra people or duplicated crew.
must_haves.why: The frames are 16:9 with cool, overcast daylight and exactly three visible crew without duplication. There are no windows, late afternoon is not established, and the sampled frames cannot independently confirm the full duration.
